╭─Pull requests──────────────────────────────────╮╭─[0]─Accounts───────────────────────────────────╮
│ No accounts are set                            ││                                                │
│                                                ││ No GitHub accounts are set, so there is        │
│                                                ││ nothing to list yet. Name them in              │
│                                                ││ ~/.review-desk/settings.json:                  │
│                                                ││                                                │
│                                                ││   {"accounts": [                               │
│                                                ││     {"login": "your-login"},                   │
│                                                ││     {"login": "your-work-login",               │
│                                                ││      "teams": [                                │
│                                                ││        {"name": "your-org/your-team",          │
│                                                ││         "since": "2026-10-01"}                 │
│                                                ││      ]}                                        │
│                                                ││   ]}                                           │
│                                                ││                                                │
│                                                ││ Each account is read by its own token, so each │
│                                                ││ must be signed in to gh. A review asked of a   │
│                                                ││ team counts as asked of you, for pull requests │
│                                                ││ opened on or after its since date. R reads the │
│                                                ││ settings again.                                │
│                                                ││                                                │
│                                                ││                                                │
│                                                ││                                                │
│                                                ││                                                │
│                                                ││                                                │
│                                                ││                                                │
│                                                ││                                                │
│                                                ││                                                │
